plan_type: Distributed Asynchronous Execution Claims & Test Requirements

claims_to_verify.claim: Decoupled Asynchronous Ingestion & Sub-50ms API Response
claims_to_verify.verification_method: API returns 202 Accepted within 50ms upon publishing event to Pub/Sub topic.
claims_to_verify.environment_required: Local Pub/Sub Emulator & Live Cloud Run

claims_to_verify.claim: At-Least-Once Pub/Sub Redelivery Preserves Exactly-Once Effects
claims_to_verify.verification_method: Delivering identical message multiple times results in exactly one external mutation via OperationClaim lease and idempotency cache.

claims_to_verify.claim: Firestore Transactional OCC Rejects Stale Concurrent Worker Writes
claims_to_verify.verification_method: Concurrent workers attempting parallel updates on the same workflow version trigger StaleWorkflowStateError without state corruption.
claims_to_verify.environment_required: Local Firestore Emulator & Live GCP Firestore

claims_to_verify.claim: Dead-Letter Forwarding & Alerting after 5 Failed Retries
claims_to_verify.verification_method: Unrecoverable poison message is routed to recoveryos-workflow-deadletter after 5 delivery attempts and marked ESCALATED.

claims_to_verify.claim: Distributed Multi-Replica Gemini Quota Rate Limiting (<= 15 RPM)
claims_to_verify.verification_method: Multiple worker tasks dispatching concurrent LLM calls comply with <= 15 RPM aggregate rate via Cloud Tasks dispatch pacing and Firestore token window.
claims_to_verify.environment_required: Local Unit Tests & Live GCP Cloud Tasks

claims_to_verify.claim: Graceful Worker Shutdown & Task Draining under SIGTERM
claims_to_verify.verification_method: Worker receives SIGTERM, stops accepting new messages, and drains active agent turns within 5 seconds.
claims_to_verify.environment_required: Local Docker & Cloud Run Revision Rotation

claims_to_verify.verification_method: Correlation ID and traceparent propagate across API -> Pub/Sub -> Worker -> Gemini -> Firestore logs.

claims_to_verify.claim: Tenant Isolation Maintained in Asynchronous Worker Execution
claims_to_verify.verification_method: Worker enforces tenant isolation on asynchronous message consumption, preventing cross-tenant data leaks.
